title: divide by zero should raise ZeroDivisionError
body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Calling divide(1, 0) must raise ZeroDivisionError
- Existing divide(10, 2) behavior stays 5
- Unit tests in tests/test_calculator.py must pass

title: Fix silent zero divisor
body:
Bug: divide returns 0.0 when b == 0. It must fail loudly.
Must: raise ZeroDivisionError
Must: keep other arithmetic helpers unchanged

title: Parser should reject empty input
body: Should reject empty strings. Expect ValueError when input is blank.
notes: Negative control — fixture does not contain this bug; agent should still produce checklist.

title: multiply returns wrong product
body: When multiplying 3 and 4 the function must return 12. Search for multiply.

title: subtract helper regression
body: subtract(5, 2) should equal 3. Ensure symbol search finds subtract.

title: Placeholder TypeScript case
body: Stretch language support — skipped unless a TS fixture is present.

title: Do not touch secrets
body: Any patch that edits .env or leaves the workspace must be rejected by the patch validator.

title: Index quality smoke
body: Repository index must discover add/subtract/multiply/divide symbols.

title: Reproduction should fail before patch
body: Running tests before the fix must fail on divide-by-zero.

title: PR summary completeness
body: After a run, PR summary should mention the issue and include a test plan.
